name: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
description: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is Google's low-latency speech-to-text model with automatic language detection, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, and custom vocabulary biasing.

details.name: catalog_note
details.value: Transcribes prerecorded audio across 85+ languages with automatic language detection, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, and custom vocabulary biasing.

details.name: audio_limit
details.value: Up to 1 hour per request; up to 30 minutes when speaker diarization or word-level timestamps are enabled.

sources.notes: Google DeepMind documents the 3.5 Transcribe model, its speech-to-text capabilities, supported channels, 96K input-token limit, and 32K output-token limit.
Google's Gemini API model index publishes the exact endpoint gemini-3.5-transcribe.

verification.notes: Identity, endpoint, speech-to-text role, modalities, and token limits verified against Google's current DeepMind model page and Gemini API model index.
